title: Memory for Arrays
statementMd:
You get to work and turn on the computer. You start coding and give little thought to the RAM role in the whole process. In this problem your task is to solve one of the problems you encounter in your computer routine.

We'll consider the RAM as a sequence of cells that can contain data. Some cells already contain some data, some are empty. The empty cells form the so-called *memory clusters*. Thus, a memory cluster is a sequence of some consecutive empty memory cells.

You have exactly $*n*$ memory clusters, the $*i*$-th cluster consists of $*a*_{*i*}$ cells. You need to find memory for $*m*$ arrays in your program. The $*j*$-th array takes $2^{*b*_{*j*}}$ consecutive memory cells. There possibly isn't enough memory for all $*m*$ arrays, so your task is to determine what maximum number of arrays can be located in the available memory clusters. Of course, the arrays cannot be divided between the memory clusters. Also, no cell can belong to two arrays.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{6}$). The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$). The next line contains $*m*$ integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ 2^{*b*_{*i*}} ≤ 10^{9}$).

## Output

Print a single integer — the answer to the problem.

## Note

In the first example you are given memory clusters with sizes 8, 4, 3, 2, 2 and arrays with sizes 8, 4, 4. There are few ways to obtain an answer equals 2: you can locate array with size 8 to the cluster with size 8, and one of the arrays with size 4 to the cluster with size 4. Another way is to locate two arrays with size 4 to the one cluster with size 8.

In the second example you are given 10 memory clusters with size 1 and 6 arrays with size 1. You can choose any 6 clusters and locate all given arrays to them.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
你开始工作并打开电脑。你开始编写代码，却很少思考 RAM 在整个过程中所起的作用。本题要求你解决日常使用计算机时遇到的一个问题。

我们将 RAM 视为一个能够存储数据的存储单元序列。其中一些存储单元已经存有数据，另一些为空。所有空存储单元构成所谓的*内存块*。因此，一个内存块就是一段连续的空存储单元序列。

现在有恰好 $*n*$ 个内存块，第 $*i*$ 个内存块由 $*a*_{*i*}$ 个存储单元组成。你的程序需要为 $*m*$ 个数组分配内存。第 $*j*$ 个数组需要占用 $2^{*b*_{*j*}}$ 个连续的存储单元。所有 $*m*$ 个数组可能无法全部装入内存，因此你的任务是确定最多能够放入现有内存块中的数组数量。当然，数组不能被分割到不同的内存块中，并且任何存储单元都不能属于两个数组。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{6}$）。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。下一行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ 2^{*b*_{*i*}} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即问题的答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，给定的内存块大小为 8、4、3、2、2，数组大小为 8、4、4。有几种方法可以得到答案 2：可以将大小为 8 的数组放入大小为 8 的内存块中，再将一个大小为 4 的数组放入大小为 4 的内存块中。另一种方法是将两个大小为 4 的数组放入大小为 8 的内存块中。

在第二个样例中，有 10 个大小为 1 的内存块和 6 个大小为 1 的数组。你可以任选 6 个内存块，并将所有给定的数组放入其中。
</statement>
